title: Privileged accounts must enforce phishing-resistant MFA
business_impact: Privileged accounts without MFA are the single most common entry point for ransomware and wire-fraud in financial institutions; a compromised admin could reach customer data through the new GenAI platform.

title: Terminated and disabled staff must not retain active access
business_impact: Orphaned active accounts are unmonitored and frequently abused by departing insiders or attackers who bought the credentials.

title: Storage resources must not be publicly accessible
business_impact: Publicly exposed storage is the leading cause of large-scale financial data breaches and would be catastrophic for customer trust and OSFI standing.

title: Security and diagnostic logging must be enabled
business_impact: Without resource logging, the SOC is blind to misuse of the GenAI platform and cannot investigate incidents or meet breach-reporting timelines.

title: AI systems must only access approved customer data
business_impact: Unapproved data in the AI context risks the model surfacing customer PII or confidential records in responses - the defining risk of this launch.

title: Confidential and Restricted data must be encrypted
business_impact: Unencrypted sensitive customer data is a reportable breach if exposed and a direct finding against privacy obligations.

title: Critical systems must forward security logs to the SIEM
business_impact: Critical systems outside the SIEM are undetectable during an attack, extending dwell time and breach impact.

title: AI activity must be logged
business_impact: Without AI activity logs the bank cannot investigate misuse, prove what data the model saw, or meet breach-notification duties.

title: Sensitive inputs to AI must be controlled
business_impact: Unfiltered prompts let customer PII and credentials flow into the model and any downstream provider - the highest-profile GenAI failure mode.

title: Excessive privileged role assignments must be limited
business_impact: Role sprawl makes least-privilege unenforceable and increases the blast radius of any single account compromise.
